# Combined Species Table

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(flextable)

# 1. Get the data
df <- params$data_list[[1]]

# 2. Create the flextable object
ft <- flextable(df)

# 3. Set widths (measurements are in inches)
ft <- width(ft, j = 1, width = 1.5) # Species_full
ft <- width(ft, j = 2, width = 5.0) # PBF

# 4. Add some basic professional formatting
ft <- theme_vanilla(ft)
ft <- set_header_labels(ft, Species_full = "Species/ESU/DPS", PBF = "Physical or Biological Feature")

# 5. Display the table
ft
